verdict: The actual final 249-row canonical batch passes this bounded source-scope, baseline/source-alias and cross-batch duplicate audit. No further exact duplicate or mathematical-scope blocker identified.
cutoff: The user instructed stopping after the current round whether or not 250 is reached; no additional source or literature campaign was undertaken for this final audit.
method: Read the complete final 249-row baseline/cross-batch retrieval index; compared final canonical texts for scope-sensitive relationships and all first 25 texts. Existing actual-source packets/independent receipts supply definitions and current-primary status, supplemented by the current-round source reads.

Compared exact manifest source aliases and an additional normalized author/title/URL/coauthor scan. Surname-only matches were treated as retrieval leads and rejected by author identity and topic, not treated as source identity.

Compared full mathematical predicates, definitions, polarity and quantifiers. Inclusion of a special case in a broader target does not imply full-target equivalence, and no similarity threshold certifies uniqueness.

Checked final question numbers are exactly Q4801–Q5049 and no stable statement identifier is assigned to two numbered questions. Earlier provisional duplicate candidates are absent from the final canonical targets; their preserved retractions are not silently restored.

concrete_comparisons.finding: Singleton-cell product bound, non-layered cube girth, toroidal-queen packing and conference-gossip score are four different targets. Q1766 is exact edge-multiset dimension, Q4242 ordinary Queen-graph structure, and Q1140 logarithmic potential growth. Surname-only Williams matches are different authors and sources.

Connected-toast everywhere perfect matching differs from generic optimal edge colouring of one-ended regular bipartite graphs. Q3383 asks d+1-colour Vizing on arbitrary bounded-degree Borel graphs; Q4806 asks d colours with regularity, bipartiteness and one end. Q4524 static connected bipartite characterization and Q1164 matching reconfiguration do not duplicate the Borel predicates.

Treeability at rank three, localization to Z[1/n]^2, reducibility between integer ranks, reducibility to the linear GL3 action on R3, and the reducibility degree of the countable rank union have distinct domains and quantifiers. In particular Q4815 targets the action on R3 rather than Ar(Z3). Q2471 amenable-action hyperfiniteness and Q3384 uniformization differ.

Amenability, indistinguishability of cells and uniqueness of the low-intensity limiting law share fixed metric/tie-rule definitions but ask different properties. Source exact-group affirmative subcase is disclosed. Q4084/Q4085 regional proximal relations and Q3384 uniformization are unrelated despite equivalence-relation vocabulary.

Universal external-field factorization under equality of product/all BP images is not the Potts-specific convexity assertion. Same-author Q21–Q24 concern monochromatic-copy CLTs, code counts and planar unit-distance avoiding density; coauthored Q1650/Q1652 concern graph enumeration and k-SAT function counts.

Uniform bounded-length alternating-cycle connectivity of all three-dimensional boxes differs from same-source Q41 Gibbs uniqueness, Q42 flow fluctuations, and Q43/Q44 entropy variational questions. It also differs from Q5026/Q5027 planar single-polyomino tiling and Q5014–Q5016 prescribed transposition networks.

Flat slice-ribbon, the normalized flat ARROW polynomial, and long-flat concordance commutativity are distinct. Same-source Q121–Q123 concern J and enhanced J invariants; Q123 polynomial realization does not identify the arrow state sum. Classical-knot sliceness/concordance neighbors Q4357/Q4360/Q3629 have different knot categories.

Large-coupling entropy ratio, conjugate-point existence, non-Anosov existence at genus at least two, magnetic Green-bundle collapse and damped general-thermostat curvature are distinct full targets. Q4824 restricts Vlambda=0 and asks one implication; Q4825 has arbitrary lambda and a two-way assertion for the damping-corrected curvature. Shared Green definitions do not make them equivalent.

Directed-landscape vertical-line metric removability differs from same-author Q37 LQG-geodesic removability. Q4827 full network-stratum dimensions differ from Q40 specified stars intersected with one geodesic. Q4828 a positive-probability long origin geodesic at a sampled time differs from Q39 exceptional-time bi-infinite-geodesic existence/dimension.

Bodart word-volume, geodesic-word growth, facet algorithms, Stoll approximation, horoboundaries/Busemann orbits and rational subsets have distinct predicates. Q14 is cogrowth-series D-finiteness, Q2712 and Q3837 count automorphism orbits, and Q4054 is intermediate girth. Classification of polynomial-geodesic groups, virtual class-two necessity and one fixed example are different full quantifiers; the rational-subset membership and bounded-language-representative problems also differ.

Douba deformed representations ask absence of unipotents versus orbit-map quasi-isometry. Integral undistorted representation, rational linearity, a specified free product, rank-one compact-target embedding, type-N geometry and VU-not-N existence differ. Q2931 virtual specialness of mock reflection groups and Q2328 extension of a virtual CAT(0) action do not ask these representation or neutrality predicates.

Fisher corrected canonical targets contain no second Kaplansky zero-divisor question. Q4850 asks embedding into a division ring, which implies but is stronger than Q1515 being a domain; no general domain-embedding equivalence is claimed. Coherence of groups, group rings, rational versus integral rings and specified group families are distinct. Q4858–Q4860 use the same greatest matrix-rank/specialization definition of universal but quantify torsion-free one-relator, locally indicable 3-manifold and locally indicable virtually compact special families separately.

Gross–Siebert projective-space mirror reconstruction, non-space-filling SLE removability, ordinary mated-CRT graph-distance scaling, the reciprocal dimension exponent and square-count-conditioned quantum regularization have different constructions/predicates. Q3057 concerns circle-domain boundary removability. Gwynne/Park coauthor aliases Q1899/Q1900/Q2496/Q2497 concern meandric loops, LIS/permutons or SLE visit order; Q4376–Q4380 concern higher-dimensional exponential metrics/thick points, not these map metrics.

Cup-product vanishing, scl exactly one-half characterization, a primitivity-rank bound and equality of bounded-cohomology seminorms are not equivalent targets. Q1522 concerns rational scl values in another setting. Shared free-group context does not identify the four predicates.

Fixed-rank fibre orbit finiteness, nonhyperbolic manifold characterization, quasiconvex-or-fibre subgroups, BNS symmetry, regular profinite identifications, Alexander semifibering and irreducible monodromy have different full targets. Q129 splitting decidability and Q1507 profinite indicability do not duplicate these. A profinite group invariant is not identified with ordinary group isomorphism merely by a shared fibre model.

Pin(2) equivariance, removal of unit ambiguity, rank-depth bounds, analytic contact element construction and trace evaluation pairing are distinct sutured Floer questions. Final depth definition retains the source hierarchy index convention. Shared Floer setup does not imply equivalence with Q2630 quasipositivity or Q4051 manifold existence.

Morales homological independence of retracts, free-product closure, positive-characteristic failure, fixed-pair field independence and abelian hierarchies have distinct definitions and quantifiers. Word measures, double rigidity, parafree Melnikov freeness and virtual b2 questions differ. Existing Q2721 absolute profinite rigidity of free/surface groups was excluded; Q2929 is RFRS invariance. Q2722 classifies all residually finite Melnikov groups, whereas Q4888 asks freeness for the explicitly parafree subclass. Q4853 asks coherence for all finitely generated parafree groups, not Melnikov freeness.

Finite section-isomorphism orbits in one fibration differ from infinite inequivalent fibrations on a fixed manifold outside partial-conjugation equivalence. Same-author Q3033/Q3034 ask specified odd/genus-two or hyperelliptic families under ordinary equivalence, not the partial-conjugation target. Fixed-genus contextual repair is disclosed in the coordinating source audit.

Arithmetic regressive versus hyperarithmetic order-preserving dichotomies, ZF strength of the Borel measure-preserving theorem, a nonprincipal ultrafilter strictly below Martin measure, and specific Lebesgue/Baire reductions differ. Q1370 concerns RK-equivalence and Q1371 an ultrafilter above Martin measure; neither is Q4897 strictly below. Their two old provisional duplicate promotions were removed. Q1368/Q1369 and Q1482/Q1483 have other domains and predicates.

Existence of some reasonable logic capturing Ptime, rank-logic containment in CPT, IFPC plus witnessed choice and interpretations capturing Ptime, all fixed finite-ring solvability, and CPT capturing Ptime are distinct logic/operator targets. Existing Q1174 bounded-colour CPT canonization and Q1175 CPT+WSC separation were excluded as duplicates. The repaired compiler includes both an evaluation algorithm and a polynomial time bound.

Discrepancy-to-sign-rank, constant-cost arbitrary-matrix rectangles, bounded-gamma2 rectangles, randomized parity size/depth gaps, equality-oracle communication, conjunction sign-rank and approximate-Fourier cosets differ. Q4909 restricts the rectangle target to XOR lifts, whereas Q4902 quantifies all Boolean matrices. General versus XOR-restricted predicates are not claimed equivalent.

Urech intermediate single-map degree growth, sublinear unbounded degree growth and dimension-only finite polynomial-exponent bounds occupy different quantifiers/regimes. Algebraic-embedding distortion, simple projective-linear subgroups, proper PSL2(Q) subgroups, Cremona residual finiteness and extension of given projective representations differ. Ordinary word/automorphic growth Q4054/Q2712 does not become birational degree growth.

Exact free-factor distance and recognition as Fix of one automorphism differ from Q4886 equality of free-word measures. Fruchter generalized Tarski, non-AH equivalence to a free product and elementary invariance are distinct. Q1618 is quasi-isometry invariance and Q2327 concerns automorphism groups, not elementary equivalence. Unnormalized virtual cohomology spectra and classification from filtered second Betti spectra are distinct invariants/tasks.

Epstein relation normal generation, finite power-law cores, nilpotency cores and detectable laws have distinct finite/universal tasks. Automaticity of one-relator groups and polynomial-time word problem are different. Hyperbolic 3-manifold rigidity from full profinite completion, asymptotic homological torsion and index-marked abelianizations are distinct data. Q1428 geometric triangulation, Q2022 isometry complexity and Q4059 Betti/geometry conditions do not duplicate them.

Huang polynomial-time ground-state optimization differs from finite-temperature Gibbs total-variation sampling; same-source Q47 specialized Max-Cut dynamics and Q48 annealed Langevin sufficient regime differ. Kogler dimension with entropy accounting for exact overlaps differs from Q3857/Q3858 absolute continuity of stationary laws. The known one-dimensional closure does not settle the arbitrary-dimension target.

Finite Artin asymptotic dimension and the stronger clique-number numerical bound are distinct full predicates. Q5048 properly cubulated Artin classification asks existence of an action by cubical automorphisms, not merely dimension; cocompact obstructions do not rule it out. Q5047 virtual cocompact Coxeter action differs from Q2328 extension of an assumed virtual cube action and Q2931 median mock reflection groups. Q5046 automaticity of CAT(0) groups retains only the unsolved automatic clause, not the closed biautomatic clause. The Cprime finite-relator ambiguity is held and unnumbered.

All Kähler subgroups of surface products versus kernels of epimorphisms to even-rank abelian groups have different full domains. Nilpotency class greater than two, integral cohomological dimension three and relative homotopy for complex maps differ. Q1424/Q1425 are Kähler-form deformation predicates, not Kähler fundamental-group classification.

Critical loop O(n), dense supercritical loop O(n), FK interfaces and the normalized SAW observable differ in model/parameter regime. Absolute-period leaf-closure analyticity, nonclosed dense-period leaf orbit closure and all closed invariant saturated sets differ in quantifiers. Q1937 concerns a local holomorphic foliation in another construction. Nonintegral-angle Veech leaves in Q5009–Q5011 are not the integer-angle absolute-period foliation.

Generalized-symmetric r-colour transposition cutoff differs from same-author Q1290 symmetric-group separation cutoff and Q1291 signed r=2 total variation; historical narrower statements were excluded. Infimal k-dilation for all classes differs from Q189 a specified high-k vanishing criterion and Q190 one specified sphere/projective-space family; those two exact historical candidates were excluded.

Graph-code density, odd-Ramsey decomposability, sumset obstructions, cop/independence equality and five ordinary/total domination predicates differ. Q1551 interval colouring and Q1552/Q1553 biregular decomposition are other graph properties. The exact half-order bound, traceable subclass, a universal additive constant, connected total-game equality cases and the asymptotic all-graph total-game constant are not equivalent full targets.

Goldberg local supercompact normal-measure multiplicity, strong compactness multiplicity, extendibility with unique minimal measures or linear Mitchell order, UA consistency, HOD coding, pseudocompact embeddings, successor-image membership, club extension and cardinal-preserving embeddings have distinct hypotheses/predicates. Pathology source definitions remain fixed; rank-into-rank origin, singular-successor pathology and regular pathology with UA differ. Existing Q80–Q84 and Q3180–Q3183 ask game determinacy, ultrafilter comparison, mutual internality, HOD successor correctness, Fréchet classification or HOD compactness, not these targets. The exact HOD-successor duplicate was excluded.

Frankl normed equilateral sets, plane colouring, finite Euclidean Ramsey sets, prescribed-distance tree maxima, complementary graph embeddings, bouquets and almost-monochromatic progressions differ. Q3580/Q3581 count distance vectors from embeddings, whereas Q4982–Q4984 maximize counts of injective prescribed-length tree copies. The two star arm lengths differ. Nearly-distance product optimality with global finite exceptions, flatness removal and exact fixed-d large-k equality have different quantifiers.

Prigge homeomorphism invariance, positive tautological dimension without connected Lie symmetry and block/smooth Euler-kernel comparison differ. Block diffeomorphisms preserve each M×face and need not commute with projection. Q4560 smoothing/diffeomorphism and Q1130 stable isotopy do not ask labelled tautological-ring relations or Euler restrictions.

Martineau full-automorphism fixed vertices, unimodular Cayley geometry, one end versus pu, pu locality, SAW locality, directed-DLA cones and directed-DLA ends differ. Q3124 geometric quasi-isometry, Q2996 causal-map percolation, Q3687 conditioned lattice clusters, Q1991 percolated SAW and Q197/Q198 other DLA models do not duplicate them. Cone confinement and ends of the nearest-neighbor induced cluster are separate predicates.

Natura strongly polynomial general LP in its real-operation/PSPACE convention differs from Q2787 fixed Delta-modular optimization or a known-target circuit-navigation bound. Lcm-denominator integral conformal decomposition is a separate arithmetic structure theorem. Polynomial Hirsch candidate was held against Q1556 and is unnumbered.

Gheysens ME classes, affine compactness for Krein spaces, L-embedded affine fixed points, closed-subgroup stability of unitarizability, T plus unitarizability compactness and weak-topology Krein inheritance differ. Q1341 is the discrete Dixmier amenability target; Q5006/Q5007 quantify locally compact groups. Q4475 factorization is not the affine fixed-point predicate and Q3747 is a subset nonexpansive-map theorem. The homogenization/source-reduction counterexample is excluded.

Ghazouani nonintegral-angle Veech volume, lattice holonomy classification in genus one and finite-holonomy leaf connected components differ. Q3467 unrestricted nonarithmetic lattice existence in higher unitary dimensions is not the specific flat-torus holonomy family. Q4950–Q4952 integer-angle absolute-period targets have a different moduli/foliation setup.

Janzer a disconnected placement in 3D, a nonsegment/nonball shape with connected placement for all containers, exact all-k shuffling, exact pair-order shuffling and all-start reachability differ. Q3761/Q3762 whole-line Kakeya subsets and Q1730 excursions are different models. Bootstrap leading constants versus all-m multi-edge asymptotic running times differ from Q34 vertex-neighbor infection. Q5019 counts K6 under no rainbow K4, not Q5035 edges lying in copies or Q2363 colour-budget clique counts.

Ivan initial-segment sums with nonzero coefficients and fixed endpoints differ from ordered word concatenation avoiding bounded-gap first occurrences. Weak cop-win structure, a common finite-set evacuation strategy implying local constructibility, and repeated delayed returns have distinct strategy quantifiers. The common-strategy equivalence proof works without countability by dynamically growing the finite set of robber-visited vertices. Q4958 finite cop number and Q4128 random-walk recurrence do not duplicate these. Torus union frequency for two translation orbits differs from generic union-count questions.

Gruslys single square-grid D4 polyomino decidability, existence without rank-two-periodic tiling, and tile-cardinality uniform dimension differ. Q4215 is strong shift equivalence of square matrices. Induced arbitrary-poset bounded-remainder packing differs from Q3362 relative dimension. Q5030/Q5031 use real planar maximal lines and three-plus colours, unlike Q1751 matroid two-colour flats. Fixed intersection self-map, unbounded-codomain and bijection thresholds have distinct map classes. Exact F-edge minima count each covered edge once rather than copies or multiplicities.

Myropolska finite-group rank-plus-one Nielsen connectivity, first-Grigorchuk triples, finite Gupta–Sidki quotient class counts, branch MF classification, exponential MN existence and Gupta–Sidki word growth differ. Q1411 is a generating graph on vertices, not a tuple Nielsen graph. Q1303 generator placement is not maximal-subgroup classification. Q2829 is Grigorchuk Dehn spectrum. Q2712 automorphic-orbit growth and geodesic-word questions are not element-volume growth. Kofinas exact k=1 tameness closure is excluded.

Eberhard mixed-sign single-equation transfer differs from Ramsey or cube-free predicates; the arbitrary-system conjecture is source-reduction refuted and excluded. Monotonicity of p(k) differs from existence of one all-k asymptotic constant; the April 2026 periodic factor does not decide either. Q5045 reset-ownership unbiased stop-game duration differs from Q4329 one-stage growing triangle bias and Q4028 complexity. Q5049 cut-group edge-transitivity graph-norm sufficiency differs from Q4994 vertex-transitive fixed-vertex graphs, Q2931 median group specialness and Euclidean distance-vector counts; percolation needs an extra fold-stability condition.
